description: Every metric the CareRoute backend exports, its recording rules, the backend process runtime and the monitoring stack itself. Generated; edit the generator, not the JSON, if you have it.
title: CareRoute AI — Triage Observability

panels.title: Backend tasks up
panels.description: Backend tasks Prometheus is scraping and reaching. 0 = the triage API is down or unregistered.

panels.title: Triage requests / min
panels.description: All triage requests received, every outcome.

panels.title: Yield (5m)
panels.description: Served / received, from the careroute:yield:ratio5m recording rule. Alert below 95%. Absent with no traffic: a ratio over zero requests is undefined, not 0%.

panels.title: Harvest (5m)
panels.description: Mean completeness of served answers. Alert below 60% while yield is healthy. Only services that serve answers report it (agent containers do not).

panels.title: Escalation share (range)
panels.description: Cases escalated to a clinician over the selected range, as a share of triage requests. Alert above 60%.

panels.title: Alerts firing
panels.description: Prometheus alerts currently firing (ALERTS series). Details in the Alerts row.

panels.title: LLM spend (range)
panels.description: Estimated LLM spend over the selected range, priced models only.

panels.title: LLM cost / triage (30m)
panels.description: Same formula as the LLMCostPerTriageHigh alert: warns at $0.096 (80% of the $0.12 efficiency gate).

panels.title: LLM p95 latency
panels.description: 95th percentile wall-clock of LLM calls, all models and outcomes. Alert above 8 s.

panels.title: LLM cache hit ratio (range)
panels.description: Share of LLM lookups answered by the exact-match cache instead of a paid provider call.

panels.title: Deployed model
panels.description: Severity-model version the backend reports (careroute_model_info).

panels.title: Uptime (range)
panels.description: Fraction of scrapes that reached a backend task over the selected range.

panels.title: Triage request rate (by outcome)
panels.description: Requests per second by outcome, plus the total.

panels.title: Outcome mix (range)
panels.description: How the selected range's requests ended.

panels.title: Human-escalation rate (share of requests)
panels.description: Escalations / triage requests over 15m, the EscalationRateAnomaly formula.

panels.title: Escalations / min
panels.description: Cases handed to a clinician per minute.

panels.title: Availability — yield (served / received)
panels.description: careroute:yield:ratio5m. Received includes failed runs and requests shed before work ran.

panels.title: Availability — harvest (how complete the answers were)
panels.description: careroute:harvest:mean5m. Yield can sit at 100% while this falls.

panels.title: Uptime (30d recording rule)
panels.description: careroute:availability:ratio30d. On AWS Prometheus keeps 6 h of data, so this is the uptime of whatever is retained.

panels.title: Which part of the answer is missing
panels.description: Degraded answer components per second. not_applicable is excluded: a case with no coordinates was never owed a route.

panels.title: Answer components by state
panels.description: Every component, present / degraded / not_applicable.

panels.title: Harvest distribution
panels.description: How complete each served answer was (careroute_answer_harvest buckets).

panels.title: Model inference latency (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Severity-model inference including SHAP. Alert: p95 above 1.5 s.

panels.title: Predictions by acuity
panels.description: Served predictions per second by acuity class. A shift in the mix is drift before labels exist.

panels.title: Acuity mix (range)
panels.description: Share of each acuity class over the selected range.

panels.title: Model confidence (median / mean)
panels.description: Calibrated confidence of served predictions. A slide down is serving skew.

panels.title: Low-confidence share (< 0.6)
panels.description: Share of predictions below the 0.6 escalation threshold.

panels.title: Confidence distribution
panels.description: careroute_model_confidence buckets over time.

panels.title: Clinician decisions (HITL) by agreement
panels.description: Escalation decisions: did the clinician's final acuity agree with the model?

panels.title: Clinician agreement (range)
panels.description: Live accuracy on human-reviewed cases: agreed / (agreed + overridden).

panels.title: HITL escalations past SLA (open)
panels.description: Pending escalations older than CAREROUTE_HITL_SLA_MINUTES — evaluated when the queue is read.

panels.title: HITL SLA breaches (range)
panels.description: Escalations that breached the review SLA (each counted once).

panels.title: Retrain queue (clinician disagreements, range)
panels.description: Clinician overrides queued as labelled retraining examples (app/memory/retrain_queue.py).

panels.title: Per-agent step duration p95
panels.description: 95th percentile step time per agent. Alert: above 2 s.

panels.title: Per-agent step duration p50
panels.description: Median step time per agent.

panels.title: Agent step rate by source
panels.description: Where each agent's answer came from: llm / model / fallback / deterministic.

panels.title: Fallback share per agent
panels.description: Share of each agent's steps that ended on the deterministic fallback — an LLM or model that is quietly not answering.

panels.title: Agent container calls by outcome
panels.description: Gateway -> agent-container calls (ok / error / rejected / breaker_open), one count per call. Only non-zero when AGENT_TRANSPORT=http — with the in-process transport the call never crosses the network and this metric stays flat. A non-ok outcome means the case was degraded and escalated to a clinician, not silently dropped.

panels.title: Agent call failure ratio
panels.description: Non-ok share of gateway -> agent-container calls, per agent. Alert-adjacent to the AgentDown signal: a rising ratio here means the container is unhealthy or the breaker is open before it fully stops answering.

panels.title: Mean step time per agent (range)
panels.description: Average step duration per agent over the selected range.

panels.title: Tool calls by tool and outcome
panels.description: Model-chosen tool calls through the registry gateway.

panels.title: Tool calls not OK
panels.description: Refused, invalid-argument, error and unknown-tool calls, by agent.

panels.title: Orchestration plans by shape
panels.description: Per-case plans chosen by agents/planner.py (full / emergency / red_flag / clarify / low_confidence / fallback). A rising fallback share means proposed plans are being rejected by the transition graph.

panels.title: LLM spend rate (USD / hour) by model
panels.description: Estimated spend, extrapolated to an hourly rate.

panels.title: LLM spend by model (range)
panels.description: Estimated spend per model over the selected range.

panels.title: LLM cost per triage
panels.description: Spend / triage requests over 30m. Warn line: $0.096.

panels.title: Tokens / min by model and direction
panels.description: Prompt and completion tokens. Alert: above 2000 tokens/s over 15m.

panels.title: Tokens per triage
panels.description: Tokens spent per triage request, by direction.

panels.title: LLM latency by model (p50 / p95 / p99, OK calls)
panels.description: Successful calls only, so a timeout cannot move the healthy percentile.

panels.title: LLM calls by outcome
panels.description: ok / error / timeout per second, by model.

panels.title: LLM provider failure rate
panels.description: Non-OK share of LLM calls. Alert above 25% over 15m.

panels.title: LLM latency distribution
panels.description: careroute_llm_latency_seconds buckets, all models.

panels.title: Router decisions by task and tier
panels.description: Which model tier the LLM router picked for each named task.

panels.title: Response-cache hit ratio by task
panels.description: Hits / lookups per task. Every hit is a provider call not paid for.

panels.title: LLM calls by model and routing reason
panels.description: Model each LLM call went to and why: base tier, or the difficulty signal (low_confidence / thin_evidence / rerun) that escalated it; override = the safety adjudicator pinned its own model.

panels.title: Per-call LLM guardrail events
panels.description: Every LLM call is screened: input PII redaction + injection screen, output LLM05 screen. blocked = the caller fell back to its deterministic path; flagged = counted and audited only.

panels.title: Guardrail blocks / output flags / rate-limited
panels.description: Input blocks, suppressed LLM outputs and 429s per second. Alert: blocks above 0.2/s.

panels.title: Guardrail block share
panels.description: Input blocks as a share of triage requests.

panels.title: Untrusted content dropped (indirect injection)
panels.description: Retrieved or remembered text dropped by the untrusted-content screen, by channel.

panels.title: Abuse monitor events
panels.description: Quarantines started and requests refused while quarantined.

panels.title: Security events (range)
panels.description: Totals over the selected range.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum(increase(careroute_guardrail_blocks_total[$__range])), "event", "input blocks", "", "") or label_replace(sum(increase(careroute_output_flags_total[$__range])), "event", "output flags", "", "") or label_replace(sum(increase(careroute_rate_limited_total[$__range])), "event", "rate-limited", "", "") or label_replace(sum(increase(careroute_untrusted_content_drops_total[$__range])), "event", "untrusted drops", "", "") or label_replace(sum(increase(careroute_abuse_events_total[$__range])), "event", "abuse events", "", "")

panels.title: Routing fallbacks by reason
panels.description: Safe fallbacks in care routing (e.g. straight-line distance when OneMap is unavailable).

panels.title: Hours-directory freshness
panels.description: Freshness of the clinic opening-hours data seen during routing.

panels.title: Fallback reasons (range)
panels.description: Why routing fell back, over the selected range.

panels.title: CPU (cores used)
panels.description: Process CPU per backend task. The task has 0.5 vCPU on the demo stack.

panels.title: Resident memory
panels.description: RSS per backend task. The demo task has 1 GiB; the model warmup OOMs below that.

panels.title: Open file descriptors
panels.description: Open FDs against the limit. SSE streams and outbound HTTP each hold one.

panels.title: Python GC collections / s
panels.description: Garbage-collector runs per generation.

panels.title: Python GC objects / s
panels.description: Objects freed per generation, and objects the collector found but could not free (a reference-cycle leak).

panels.title: Process uptime
panels.description: Time since the oldest running backend process started. Resets on every deploy, Spot reclaim or crash.

panels.title: Restarts (range)
panels.description: Backend process starts seen over the selected range (deploys, Spot reclaims, crashes).

panels.title: Alerts firing now
panels.description: Every Prometheus alert in the firing state, with its labels.

panels.title: Alerts by state
panels.description: Pending and firing alerts over time.

panels.title: Scrape targets up
panels.description: 1 = Prometheus reached the target on its last scrape.

panels.title: Scrape duration
panels.description: How long each scrape took.

panels.title: Samples per scrape
panels.description: Series returned per scrape — a jump means a new high-cardinality label.

panels.title: Prometheus head series
panels.description: Active series in the TSDB head (drives Prometheus memory).

panels.title: Samples ingested / s
panels.description: Rate of samples appended to the TSDB.

panels.title: Rule group evaluation time
panels.description: Last evaluation duration per rule group. Should stay far below the 15 s interval.

panels.title: Rule evaluation failures
panels.description: Failed rule evaluations per second, by group.

panels.title: Prometheus → Alertmanager notifications
panels.description: Alerts sent, failed and dropped on the way to Alertmanager.

panels.title: Alertmanager alerts by state
panels.description: Alerts Alertmanager is holding: active, suppressed, unprocessed.

panels.title: Alertmanager notifications
panels.description: Notifications attempted and failed, by integration. None are configured yet (null receivers).

panels.title: Monitoring task memory
panels.description: RSS of Prometheus and Alertmanager.

panels.title: Monitoring task CPU
panels.description: CPU cores used by Prometheus and Alertmanager.
